instruction: Adjust all three desktop images at once so that each fits within 800x600 pixels, ensuring the aspect ratio is maintained.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP lacks built-in batch resize functionality accessible through the standard GUI. Resizing multiple images at once requires either scripting automation (Python-Fu/Script-Fu) or the use of GIMP's BIMP plugin, neither of which is available in the OSWorld environment. Each image must be opened and resized individually through the GUI.
